user_decision: Fillout feeds the Applicant Dashboard and should be connected to the Agent OS.

transport: Google Drive resume folder / direct resume URL
current_pipeline.current_polling: Dashboard invokes process_applications.py in-process approximately every 5 minutes when enabled

canonical_integration_boundary: Agent OS should integrate with the Applicant Dashboard's normalized administrative/workflow layer, not create an independent competing raw-Fillout ingestion or applicant-decision pipeline.
rationale: The dashboard already owns duplicate detection/processed-row semantics.
The dashboard already keeps Affirmative Action/EEO self-ID material separate from hiring-facing application material.
The dashboard already resolves resumes, generates PDFs and tracks applicant statuses/notes/actions.
The dashboard already implements RTEC-specific screening/opening/location logic.
A second direct raw-Fillout pipeline would risk duplicate applicant records, inconsistent field mapping, broken EEO separation and divergent workflow state.
required_agent_capabilities: applicant.list and applicant.search over normalized dashboard records
applicant.get_document_metadata and authorized local document retrieval
applicant.flag_summary with provenance and human-reviewable reasons
applicant.timeline/history for status and human/agent actions
applicant.sync_status for Fillout/Google bridge health and last successful pull
applicant.apply_status_change only under explicit autonomy/approval policy
applicant.audit_events for all reads/writes of applicant records

privacy_boundaries.eeo_view: Affirmative Action/EEO self-ID data remains logically and access-control separated and is never exposed to ordinary candidate evaluation tools.
privacy_boundaries.restricted_data: Applicant PII, references, employment history and uploaded files remain outside GitHub and general durable memory.
privacy_boundaries.durable_agent_memory: Only generalized recruiting/process knowledge, schemas, system state and non-person-specific insights may be promoted.

implementation_preference.primary: Expose a small authenticated provider-neutral local API/MCP adapter over dashboard.db and existing dashboard/process_applications business logic.
implementation_preference.event_delivery: Write an append-only local event/outbox table and let Agent OS consume/acknowledge events; avoid scraping GUI state.
implementation_preference.optional_fillout_acceleration: Fillout supports REST webhooks on submission, so a webhook can later be used as a low-latency wake-up signal, but the dashboard processor should remain the canonical normalizer/idempotent importer.
implementation_preference.fallback: Agent OS can call the dashboard's existing 'check Fillout now' sync function through the adapter when event delivery is unavailable.

approval_policy: Agent may automatically read/summarize normalized applicant records within authorized HR scope for administrative purposes.
Agent may track missing documents, deadlines, status, scheduling needs, and user-created follow-up commitments.
Agent may prepare interview, clarification, offer, rejection, or other correspondence only after the user supplies or confirms the underlying employment decision/action.
The Agent must not rank applicants, recommend who should be hired or rejected, or make employment decisions.
Restricted self-identification information remains outside ordinary recruiting tools and must not be used for employment decisions.
health_checks: latest source row timestamp versus dashboard ingestion timestamp
Fillout integration disconnect or stale source sheet
related_projects: Personal Agent OS / RTEC HR process model
